integrity.critical_source_input: Wang--Wen Theorem 1.3 and its theta-divisor interpretation supply proper intersection for general P; Beauville supplies the rank-r generalized theta class in the classical trivial-determinant setting.
integrity.proof_status: The exact degree follows by a complete intersection-theoretic calculation using the Abel--Jacobi Poincare formula and the pullback rule for a principal polarization.

scientific_limitations: The formula is a scheme-theoretic degree and does not assert that the exceptional-point divisor is reduced.
The proper-intersection input is proved for a general principal bundle in the Wang--Wen setup, not for every semistable bundle.
The argument is over the complex numbers and uses the classical principal theta polarization on the Jacobian.
title: Exact degree of the exceptional-point divisor in the Wang--Wen vanishing theorem
